scores.notes: Baseline pair001: Left shows the pit under a dark night sky lit by torches, with tall blue-grey cylindrical walls and no stairs. Right shows the pit in bright daylight, built of sandy stone with an internal staircase, a gate and palms at the rim. The night versus full daylight is the clearest conflict, and neither description asks for a change of time.

Baseline pair002: Peter in the left foreground (brazier courtyard) and Peter stepping from the boat on the right both have curly greying hair, a grey beard, a middle-aged weathered face and the same skin tone.
Baseline pair003: Both show a wooden boat with a mast on a dark, stormy sea at night, with the moon behind clouds and a rocky, hilly coast with buildings on the right.

Baseline pair004: Left shows the storm at night; right shows the rain easing as the descriptions ask. Both have a wooden boat with a mast on open water and a hilly coast with a village along the shore, so the place is compatible.
Baseline pair005: Daniel hauled from the pit (left) and Daniel before Belshazzar (right) both have short grey hair, a short grey beard, a lean older face and the same blue cloak with a shoulder bag.

Baseline pair006: Both show tall curling teal water walls on each side of a sandy, rocky seabed path under a dim evening or night sky. Left has a storm and a fire glow while right is clearer twilight with cliffs on the far shore, but the layout of the place is compatible.
Baseline pair007: Daniel at the feast (left) and Daniel standing among the lions (right) share short grey hair, a grey beard, an older lean face, the same skin tone and the blue cloak with a bag.

Baseline pair008: Left places the boat in a narrow, calm stretch of water a few metres from a lakeside stone village and moored boats, with land close on both sides. Right shows the boat far out on open rough sea with only a distant mountainous coast, so the boat's position does not match for the same occasion.
Baseline pair009: Both show the same morning lakeshore: a pebbly beach with a fire, a wooden boat, a lake running into a valley between hills, and a white village on the right bank.
Baseline pair010: Both show a wooden boat with a torn sail on a dark stormy sea at night, with the moon in clouds and a hilly coast with a village and cypresses behind.

Baseline pair011: Daniel lowered at the pit (left) and Daniel at the feast (right) both have short grey hair, a short grey beard, an older lean face, the same skin tone and the blue cloak with a shoulder bag.

Baseline pair012: Daniel at the feast (left) and the smaller Daniel among the lions (right) both have grey hair, a grey beard, an older thin face and the same blue cloak with a bag; nothing conflicts.

Baseline pair013: Peter in the courtyard foreground (left) and Peter lifting the lame man (right) both have curly dark hair greying at the temples, a grey beard and a middle-aged face, and carry a net and staff.

Baseline pair014: The left description does not name Moses, so I identified him as the elderly man with a shepherd's staff beside Aaron. He has long white hair and a full white beard, matching Moses striking the rock on the right.
Baseline pair015: Kneeling David at the anointing (left) and David dodging the spear (right) are both clean-shaven youths with short dark curly hair, slim builds and the same skin tone.
Baseline pair016: Both show curling green-teal water walls on a sandy shore, with a far shore of red cliffs and a walled hilltop city on the right.

Baseline pair017: Both show tall curling teal water walls over a rocky, sandy seabed under a stormy sky with radiant light at the center. Left also shows the far shore's cliffs and city, which the wall hides in the right view, so the views are compatible.

Baseline pair018: Left shows the storm easing at dusk and right the storm at night, which the descriptions ask for. Both have a wooden boat with a torn sail on open water near a hilly coast with buildings, so the place matches.

Baseline pair019: The left description does not name Moses, so I identified him as the elderly man with a staff beside Aaron. He has long white hair, a full white beard and a brown cloak, matching Moses with the raised rod on the right.
Baseline pair020: Moses seated with raised arms (left) and Moses leading through the sea (right) are both elderly men with white hair and long white beards, the same face shape and skin tone.
Baseline pair021: David at the stream (left) and kneeling David at the anointing (right) are both clean-shaven teenagers with short dark curly hair and a slim build.
Baseline pair022: Kneeling David (left) and David releasing the sling (right) are both clean-shaven youths with short dark curly hair and a slim build, wearing a similar brown tunic and bag.

Baseline pair023: Peter is clear on the left: greying curly hair and grey beard, lifting the lame man. The right description names no one, only several disciples and fishermen on the shore, so I cannot single out Peter there.

Baseline pair024: Jesus on the water (left) has long dark hair and a dark beard. Jesus on the cross (right) is small and his head is bowed, but he shows the same long dark hair, dark beard and slim face, and nothing conflicts.
Baseline pair025: Jesus on the cross (left, small) and Jesus on the water (right) both have long dark hair parted in the middle, a dark full beard and a slim face.
Baseline pair026: David slinging the stone (left) and kneeling David at the anointing (right, head bowed) both have short dark curly hair, a clean-shaven youthful face and a slim build.

Baseline pair027: The left description does not name Moses, so I identified him as the elderly man with a staff beside Aaron. He has long white hair and a long white beard, matching the seated Moses with raised arms on the right.
Baseline pair028: Both show curling teal water walls by a sandy shore, with red cliffs and a walled hilltop city on the far shore. The parting stage and the sky differ, but the place matches.
Baseline pair029: Both show the sea splitting into tall curling teal walls under a dark stormy sky with a fiery golden glow at the center, above a sandy, rocky shore and seabed.
Baseline pair030: Daniel in the pit centre-left (left) and centre of the den (right): same lean older face, short grey hair, short grey beard, blue robe over white tunic with shoulder satchel.
Baseline pair031: Kneeling youth under Samuel's horn (left) vs crouching youth at stream (right): both young, clean-shaven, short dark curly hair, slim build, brown tunic.
Baseline pair032: Foreground Peter by the brazier (left) vs Peter lifting the lame man (right): both middle-aged with curly dark-grey hair and grey-streaked full beard, net over shoulder.
Baseline pair033: Daniel standing among lions (left) vs Daniel gazing up at the fiery throne (right): same short grey hair, trimmed grey beard, lean face, blue robe and satchel strap.
Baseline pair034: Jesus at the tomb mouth (left) vs Jesus on the central cross (right, small but face visible): long dark hair and dark beard in both, no conflicting cue.
Baseline pair035: Daniel in the den (left) vs Daniel before Belshazzar (right, large): same short grey hair, short grey beard, lean older face, blue robe over white tunic.
Baseline pair036: Youth slinging at Goliath (left) vs youth choosing stones (right): both clean-shaven teens with short dark curly hair, slim build, brown ragged tunic and bag.
Baseline pair037: Daniel before Belshazzar (left) vs Daniel hauled from the den (right): same grey cropped hair, short grey beard, lean face, blue robe with white tunic.
Baseline pair038: Crouching youth at stream (left) vs youth dodging Saul's spear (right): both clean-shaven, young, short dark curly hair, slim build, brown tunic.

Baseline pair039: Left Moses at the rock shows a long white beard and hair, but right Moses is seen from behind facing the sea, face hidden; only white hair is visible, so identity cannot be confirmed.
Baseline pair040: Peter steadying the lame man (left) vs Peter stepping onto water (right): curly dark-grey hair, grey-streaked beard, weathered middle-aged face, net over shoulder and staff in both.

Baseline pair041: Left description only says 'disciples' and does not single out Peter; the foreground net-carrier with grey curly hair and beard resembles right-side Peter, but the subject cannot be identified from the text.
Baseline pair042: Jesus on the water (left) vs Jesus at the tomb (right): same long dark hair, dark full beard, long face, white tunic with dark blue mantle.
Baseline pair043: Moses at the rock (left, small but face visible) vs Moses seated on the hill (right): long white hair, long white beard, elderly, brown cloak and staff in both.
Baseline pair044: Peter leaping ashore (left) vs Peter lifting the lame man (right): curly grey-streaked hair, grey beard, broad weathered middle-aged face in both.

Baseline pair046: Youth dodging Saul's spear (left) vs youth choosing stones (right): clean-shaven teen with short dark curly hair, slim build, brown tunic in both.
Baseline pair047: Jesus on the cross (left, small) vs Jesus at the tomb (right): long dark hair and dark beard in both, no conflicting cue.

Baseline pair048: Both show the dry sandy sea floor between tall green-teal wave walls under a stormy sky with a crowd receding down the corridor; the right adds red cliffs on the far shore, compatible with a different viewpoint.
Baseline pair049: Jesus at the tomb (left) vs Jesus standing in the boat stern (right): same long dark hair, dark beard, white tunic and dark blue mantle.

Baseline pair050: Both show a sandy dry corridor between towering dark-green water walls receding to the horizon under a cloudy sky; left adds red cliffs and palms at the shore, otherwise compatible from a different angle.
Baseline pair051: Peter leaping ashore (left) vs Peter stepping onto the water (right): curly dark-grey hair, grey-streaked beard, weathered middle-aged face.
Baseline pair052: Jesus on the cross (left) vs Jesus standing in the boat (right): long dark hair and dark beard in both, no conflicting cue.

Baseline pair055: Moses at the sea (left, large) vs Moses at the rock (right, small but face visible): long white hair, long white beard, elderly, brown cloak and staff.

Baseline pair056: Left description only says 'disciples' and does not single out Peter; a net-carrying man with grey curly hair and beard by the boat resembles right Peter, but the subject is not identified by the text.
Baseline pair057: Right description concerns Aaron and the pig and never names Moses; a white-bearded elder with staff beside Aaron resembles seated left Moses, but the text does not single him out.

Baseline pair058: Left description only says 'disciples' and does not single out Peter; the net-carrying grey-bearded man by the boat resembles right Peter on the water, but the subject is not identified by the text.
Baseline pair059: Jesus at the tomb (left, arm raised) and Jesus on the waves (right) both have long dark wavy hair, a full dark beard, a similar adult face and a cream tunic under a blue-grey cloak.

Baseline pair060: Daniel standing among the lions (left) and Daniel being lifted out (right) are both older men with short grey hair, a short grey beard and a slim build, in the same blue robe with a shoulder pouch. Baseline pair061: Jesus on the water (left) and Jesus standing in the stern (right) have the same long dark hair, full dark beard and adult face, in a cream tunic and blue cloak.

Baseline pair065: Daniel being lifted out (left) has short grey hair, a grey beard and an older face, in a blue robe over a cream tunic with a pouch. The small, upward-gazing Daniel on the right matches in grey hair and beard, age and outfit, although his face is small and in shadow.

Baseline pair066: Moses at the sea (left, seen mostly from behind but showing a profile) and the seated Moses on the hill (right) are both very old men with long white hair and a long full white beard.

Baseline pair067: Peter stepping from the boat (left) and Peter lifting the lame man (right) share curly dark hair with grey, a grey-streaked full beard, a middle-aged weathered face and a net over the shoulder.

Baseline pair068: Both show a dirt road with dry-stone walls, olive groves, cypresses and a white village on rolling hills in golden light. The left also shows a lake in the distance that the right's angle leaves out, and nothing conflicts.
Baseline pair069: Jesus at the tomb (left) and Jesus in the boat's stern (right) both have long dark hair, a dark beard and a narrow face, in a cream tunic and blue-grey cloak.

Baseline pair070: Peter by the brazier (left) and Peter stepping onto the water (right) both have curly dark-grey hair, a full grey-streaked beard and a middle-aged face, with a net over the shoulder and a staff.

Baseline pair072: Peter leaping from the boat clutching his coat (left) and Peter at the brazier (right) both have curly dark-grey hair, a grey-streaked full beard and the same broad middle-aged face.

The Daniel on the rooftop (right) has distinctly deep-brown skin and a fuller beard, while his cream tunic stays light, so the skin difference is not just shadow.

Baseline pair075: The seated Moses supported by Aaron and Hur (left) and Moses leading the people through the sea (right) are both very old men with long white hair and a long flowing white beard.

Baseline pair076: Both show dry-stone walls, olive trees, terraced hills, a village and the same white columned temple on a hillside in warm light. The left adds a lake that the courtyard angle on the right does not show.
Baseline pair077: Peter at the brazier (left) and Peter leaping from the boat (right) both have curly dark-grey hair, a grey-streaked full beard and the same middle-aged face.
Baseline pair078: The left description names only Aaron and a crowd, so Moses is not singled out. An old man with white hair and a white beard holding a staff there does resemble the right's Moses.

Baseline pair082: The kneeling David being anointed (left, head bowed) and David dodging Saul's spear (right) are both clean-shaven youths with short curly dark hair, in a brown tunic.

Baseline pair083: Both show a rural edge of olive groves, cypresses, dry-stone walls, a stone path or road and white houses on hills in golden evening light. The right's view also takes in a lake, and nothing conflicts.

Baseline pair085: David slinging (left) and David choosing stones (right) are both beardless youths with short curly dark hair, in a rough brown tunic.

Baseline pair086: Both show the same kind of wooden boat with a single mast, a torn sail and a lantern, on a choppy lake with a village and hills on the shore. Storm and rain on the left giving way to clearing sky on the right is the change the descriptions ask for.
Baseline pair087: David dodging Saul's spear (left) and David choosing stones (right) are both clean-shaven youths with short curly dark hair and rosy cheeks, in a brown tunic.
Baseline pair088: Left: the young man dodging the spear by the lyre; right: the slinger. Both are clean-shaven youths with short dark curly hair, slim build and tanned skin.

Baseline pair089: Left: the leader with a staff walking between the water walls; right: the seated figure whose arms are held up. Both are elderly men with white shoulder-length hair and full white beards, and similar lined faces.

Baseline pair090: Left: the small figure raising a rod at the rock beside the ephod-wearer; right: the leader with a staff at the front of the crowd. Both are elderly men with white hair and white beards.

Baseline pair091: Left: the man on the rooftop gazing up at the fire; right: the man in the den. Both have short grey receding hair, a short grey beard, brown skin, a blue robe over a white tunic and a shoulder satchel.

Baseline pair092: Left: Moses is the white-haired, white-bearded elder raising a rod at the rock. The right description names Aaron and the crowd but not Moses, so no figure is singled out as him; the white-bearded elder with a staff beside Aaron resembles the left Moses.
Baseline pair093: Left: the figure standing in the stern; right: the figure standing on the waves. Both have long dark-brown hair, a full beard, a slim face, and a white tunic under a blue-grey robe.

Baseline pair095: Left: the figure on the water; right: the figure at the tomb entrance. Both have long dark-brown hair, a full beard, and a white tunic with a blue-grey robe.

Baseline pair099: Both show a calm lake in morning light with a pebbly beach, a beached wooden boat, a charcoal fire, and a hillside village of stone houses with palms on the right.

Baseline pair101: Left: the figure on the central cross; right: the figure standing in the boat. Both have long dark hair and a dark beard. The crucified figure is small but legible.

Baseline pair106: Left: the man with a staff by the brazier; right: the man leaping ashore. Both have short curly salt-and-pepper hair, a grey beard and a broad weathered middle-aged face.

Baseline pair114: Left: the man standing among the lions; right: the man being hauled up. Both have short grey hair, a grey beard, brown skin, and a blue robe over a white tunic with a satchel.

Compared the staff-bearing elder leading the file (left) with the rod-raising figure on the rock (right): both have long white hair, full white beard, aged face, light skin and a dark cloak over a pale robe.
Both show a sandy corridor between towering blue water walls under a dark night sky with a faint pillar of fire/cloud ahead; the right view is from the shore end of the same dry path.
Both show the dry sandy sea bed between tall dark water walls at night; the right image is the same corridor seen from the Egyptian end with the far mountains visible, matching the left's horizon.

The man pulled from the pit (left) and the praying man by the fiery river (right) both have short grey hair, a trimmed grey beard, middle age, a blue garment over white and a shoulder bag; the right face reads warmer only under the firelight.

Took the lead disciple stepping ashore with staff and net (left) as Peter and compared him with the leaping Peter (right): both have dark curly hair streaked grey, a short grey-flecked beard, tan skin and a stocky middle-aged build.
Daniel before Belshazzar (left) and Daniel by the fiery river (right) both have cropped grey hair, a short grey beard, medium-tan skin, a blue cloak over a white tunic and a shoulder bag.
Peter at the courtyard fire (left) and the lead disciple with staff and net on the beach (right) share dark curly hair, a short greying beard, tan skin and a stocky build.
Peter in the courtyard (left) and Peter leaping from the boat (right) both have dark curly hair with grey, a short grey-flecked beard, tan skin and the same stocky middle-aged frame.

The youth stooping at the brook (left) and the bowed boy being anointed (right) both have dark curly hair, a clean-shaven light-skinned face, a slight frame and a plain brown short tunic; the left reads a little older but still a youth.
Jesus in the stern (left) and the glowing figure on the water (right) both have long brown hair, a brown beard, light skin and a blue cloak over a white robe.

Both show a calm lake shore with a beached fishing boat, a charcoal fire on the sand, rounded green-brown hills, palms and a cluster of white flat-roofed houses; the right is the same shoreline from the water side.
The bowed boy under the horn of oil (left) and the sling-throwing boy (right) share dark curly hair, a round clean-shaven light-skinned face, a small slight build and a brown short tunic.

The boy dodging Saul's spear (left) and the youth at the brook (right) both have dark curly hair, a clean-shaven light-skinned face, a slim build and a brown short tunic with belt; the right looks a touch older but still adolescent.

The white-haired elder with staff beside the priest at the camp (left, seen mostly from behind) and the seated elder with raised arms (right) both have long white hair, a full white beard, light skin, an aged frame and a dark cloak over a pale robe.

The glowing figure on the water (left) and Jesus at the tomb (right) both have long dark hair, a dark beard, light-olive skin and a blue cloak over a white robe; the left is small but the face and hair read clearly.
The elder with staff at the camp (left) and the elder leading the file through the sea (right) both have long white hair, a full white beard, light skin and a dark cloak over a pale robe.
The bowed boy being anointed (left) and the boy dodging the spear (right) both have dark curly hair, a round clean-shaven light-skinned face, a small slight build and a plain brown short tunic.

Compared the crucified central figure (left) with the standing Jesus in the stern (right): both have shoulder-length dark brown hair, a short dark beard, light-olive skin, slim build and the same thirties-looking age. The left figure is small but the hair and beard are legible.

Both show a wooden single-masted fishing boat with a lantern on a broad lake ringed by rounded brown hills under a dark storm sky. The left is lit by a horizon glow and the right by moonlight with a shore town visible, but the lake and hill forms are compatible with one night at different moments.

Both are the same night sea: moon through torn storm clouds, heavy whitecapped waves, the same wooden boat with mast and hanging lantern. The right view frames only open water where the left shows the shore, which is a viewpoint difference rather than a conflict.

Peter is the man gripping the lame man's hand (left) and the net-carrying man with a staff stepping from the boat (right): both have short grey curly hair, a grey beard, a stocky older build and a net over the shoulder.
